🇩🇪 A1 GERMAN VOCABULARY: Kleidung (Clothes)

die Jacke = jacket
der Mantel = coat
der Pullover = sweater
der Schuh = shoe
die Socke = sock
die Mütze = hat/cap

💡 Tip: Learn der/die/das with every noun.
